objective: Reduce foundational lexicon debt by provisionally promoting conditioned distinctions as the primitive mathematical object of RT Mechanics.

promotion.title: Primitive Conditioning Principle
promotion.statement: Within this provisional ontology reduction, a conditioned distinction is the smallest admissible mathematical object used by RT Mechanics.

conditioned_distinction.meaning: Distinction a conditioned by context b.

demotions.interpretation: Represents a distinction whose conditioning context has been intentionally suppressed.

demotions.reason: Carries arithmetic assumptions and therefore remains a projection-facing notation rather than a primitive RT object.

new_axioms.statement: No admissible distinction exists independently of conditioning.
Conditioning precedes all admissible relational composition.

<*>_x.previous_role: general relational operator over admissible blocks
<*>_x.new_role: Meta-relation schema whose default typed operands are conditioned distinctions or explicitly declared context-suppressed abstractions thereof.

appendix_f_updates.family_note: OQ_COND_001 through OQ_COND_005 are resolved under RESOLVED_L2 and are tracked together as a Conditioning Theory dependency family (campaign MPF_COND_CAMPAIGN_RUN_001).
non_promotions: Conditioning composition is not promoted to theorem status by this patch.
Conditioning propagation is not promoted to theorem status by this patch.

WholeExpressionPrimacy.reason: Primitive objects are already relationally conditioned.

RTMechanicsRecursiveCompletion.reason: Recursive completion can now be read over conditioned objects without treating isolated distinction as primitive.

TracePriority.reason: Trace can be read as conditioning lineage.

AdmissibilityStructure.reason: Admissibility belongs first to conditioned relations and only derivatively to suppressed abstractions.

design_constraints: No isolated distinction participates directly in RT except as an explicitly declared context-suppressed abstraction.
Every lawful RT expression must be reducible to conditioned distinctions or declared abstractions thereof.
Conditioning is directional unless explicitly promoted to symmetric conditioning.
Arithmetic remains a lawful projection but not a primitive ontology.

implementation_tasks.task: Replace primitive references to D(a) with <a>_b where ontologically appropriate while preserving historical source wording.
Update operator registry to define <*>_x over conditioned distinctions.
Revise Appendix F to track Conditioning Theory gaps as a single dependency family without closing them prematurely.
Audit textbook for implicit isolated distinctions and convert them to conditioned forms where required by current governance.

governance_notes: This patch is an internal ontology reduction only. It does not prove conditioning composition, invariants, equivalence, metrics, or arithmetic recovery.
The earlier induction RT-IND-Conditioning-001 is not revoked. It is sharpened by treating D(a) as a context-suppressed abstraction rather than the primitive object.
Conditioning family claims are elevated to RESOLVED_L2 following campaign MPF_COND_CAMPAIGN_RUN_001.
